timeline_summary: The player begins by observing a red Saurian on a hillside in Natlan before engaging a Wayob Manifestation in combat. The battle intensifies as the active character switches to Wanderer, who sustains critical damage and is forced to retreat from the large enemy.

environment.location: Grassy hillside in Natlan near a mechanical structure

events.description: Player stands still on a hillside observing a red Saurian and distant ruins.
Player runs across an open field toward a large red creature.
Jean engages the Wayob Manifestation in combat, surrounded by green elemental effects.
Wanderer takes over combat, triggering Swirl reactions against Saurian enemies near a mechanical structure.
Wanderer attempts to flee from the large red enemy while at critically low health.

player_arc.status_notes: The player started at full health with Jean but ended the sequence with Wanderer at critically low health (550/16728) and unable to switch characters.
